requirements.title: Mis reservas y cancelar
requirements.statement: WHEN a socio opens "Mis reservas" THE system SHALL list their own reservations with state, and WHEN they cancel one whose start date is after today THE system SHALL cancel it and free its units

criteria.text: GIVEN Lucía has 2 × Casco 2026-12-05..2026-12-07 and no one else has reservations WHEN she opens "Mis reservas" THEN the user sees "2 × Casco del 2026-12-05 al 2026-12-07 — Reservada" and no reservation of other members
